title: Increase MATRIX_LR to 0.075
description: Continued Muon learning rate acceleration (0.06→0.075, 1.25× increment) following Round 2 success
reflection: Hypothesis failed. Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.075 resulted in val_bpb 0.996895, a regression of 0.000895 from baseline 0.996000. The optimal MATRIX_LR lies between 0.06 and 0.075; we overshot it. Round 2's 1.5× acceleration (0.04→0.06) worked well, but further 1.25× scaling destabilized convergence. The learning rate landscape is narrower than expected—0.06 is closer to optimal than predicted. Future attempts should explore smaller increments (0.06→0.065) or move to untested parameter families (EMBEDDING_LR, WEIGHT_DECAY).
